newEvidence.finding: The current public Hera charging portal exposes deterministic power bands for its charging-point map: Default 0-22 kW, Rapido 23-50 kW, Veloce 51-100 kW, Powered 101-150 kW and Ultra above 150 kW. These bands are authoritative technical classification evidence but do not by themselves establish the energy price for each band.

newEvidence.finding: The current tariff page exposes exact post-charge occupancy penalties: after 60 minutes from charge completion, 0.08 EUR/min for Type 2/Type 3A from 07:00 to 23:00 every day and 0.15 EUR/min for CHAdeMO/CCS2 all day. The page visibly contains sections for flat and consumption offers, but the energy-price numeric fields are not present in the crawlable static text and appear to require a dynamic/static-bundle or live-traffic surface.
